messages.body: This should also show the available people that can be org managers

Done in Role Onboarding v2 (this v1 is now archived): every add modal now lists the people in Brightwater USD who could take the role, each with a checkbox (Marcus ticked here), leaving out whoever already holds it; emails stay below for anyone not on the list. Proposal recorded in the walkthrough note: the list is the district's people who already have an Endless account (school email), and how an Organization knows its people is still open.
